page.title: Composer
page.purpose: Bind a style to a brief and show the fully resolved execution plan before anything runs. This is the surface where money is spent, so the cost of a decision must be visible before it is incurred.

priorities.statement: Resolve and render are two distinct stages, and the operator sees the plan between them.
priorities.notes: The resolved plan names the strategy, ordered operations, merged parameters, conditioning inputs, and expected execution path. Nothing executes until the operator asks. This mirrors image-tools' own explain-before-execute pattern and is what makes an unexpected result readable rather than mysterious.

priorities.statement: Palette slots show what they resolved to, against the active brand.
priorities.notes: A $brand.primary slot displays both the slot name and the concrete colour it bound to, so the operator can see the palette lock working rather than trusting it.

priorities.statement: A refusal is as informative as a success.
priorities.notes: An unresolved slot, a restrictive adapter licence, or a missing scaffold parameter each names the specific condition and what would fix it.

states.description: Style and palette data load without collapsing the plan frame.
The last resolved plan remains visible with an explicit freshness notice.
Plan resolution names the failed dependency and offers retry.
The resolved portion of a plan remains inspectable while optional metadata is pending.
No style is selected and the operator is routed to the catalog.
Prompts the operator to pick a style, with a route back to the catalog.
A style is bound but required brief fields are unfilled. Names each missing field rather than disabling the resolve control silently.

The full plan is shown: strategy, operations in order, merged parameters, resolved palette bindings, conditioning inputs, expected execution path, and whether the run is free or metered. Render is available.
A slot does not resolve against the active brand. Names the slot and the brand, and offers to switch brand or amend the style. No default colour is substituted.
The plan depends on an adapter whose licensing forbids commercial use. Names the adapter and its restriction, and marks the plan unreleasable before any spend occurs.
Work is in flight. Shows which execution path is being used and allows cancellation.
